title: Mixed Conditionals / I-Conditional Ezimiswe
bridge: NgisiZulu, i-conditionals ezimiswe azinokuthonjana kwazo: siyathusa ukuhlanganyela ixesha ze-verbs ezikwazi ukudonsa izihlakazelo zamandulo neziphumo zamahora kanye nezinye izimo zamahora neziphumo zamandulo. NgesiNgisi, lawa mahlanganiswa athathwe ngendlela efanele: umthombo (if-clause) nomsebenzi (main clause) usebenzisa ixesha ze-verbs ezinikezwa ezingavumelani nalokho okufaneleka ngesiZulu. Isiqingatha esikhulu yikuthi akunakuthandazela ngokwesilo i-conditionals kusiZulu kusiNgisi; kufuneka udlale ngokomthelela wokusebenza kwakho kwangaphakathi kwazo zonke izinhlanganiswa ezimbalwa mibilane nokwazi ukuthi nini uzosebenzisa.
rule: I-conditionals ezimiswe zihlanganyela isimo somandulo neziphumo zamahora (uhlu 3 + uhlu 2) okanye isimo samahora neziphumo zamandulo (uhlu 2 + uhlu 3). Uhlelo 1: If + past perfect, would + umthelela we-verb (isimo somandulo, iphumo yamahora). Isibonelo: Uma ngabe ngilondoloze ngokuningi, ngabe nginekhuselo elungile ngoku. Uhlelo 2: If + simple past, would have + past participle (isimo samahora, iphumo yamandulo). Isibonelo: Uma nginguwe, ngabe ngitshele inyaniso. Izibopho: E-conditional ezimiswe, kunzima ukusebenzisa 'were' esikhundleni se-'was' ngabantu bonke esimweni somandulo (If I were...). Ngaphandle kwalokho, umwebo wama-clause angavunywa ngaphandle kokuguqula umthelela, kodwa isikhala sisehlathululweni nje uma isimo siseqaleni.

concept_examples.text: If I had studied more, I would be more confident now.
concept_examples.translation: Uma ngabe ngilondoloze ngokuningi, ngabe nginekhona ngoku.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd ˈstʌdid mɔːr, aɪ wʊd biː mɔːr ˈkɑːnfɪdənt naʊ/

concept_examples.text: If she were more organized, she would have finished the project yesterday.
concept_examples.translation: Uma yena engabe enomthelela omuhle, ngabe esekuphethe iprojekthi ngemihla emashumi amabili.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃiː wɜːr mɔːr ˈɔːrɡənaɪzd, ʃiː wʊd hæv ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə ˈprɒdʒekt ˈjestərdeɪ/

concept_examples.text: If I hadn't missed the flight, I wouldn't be stuck in this hotel.
concept_examples.translation: Uma ngabe angiphuthile iflight, angibe ngisaphukile kulelihotele.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ ˈhædənt mɪst ðə flaɪt, aɪ ˈwʊdənt biː stʌk ɪn ðɪs hoʊˈtel/

concept_examples.text: If he were here, he would have solved the problem easily.
concept_examples.translation: Uma yena engabe apha, ngabe esephule isiqingatha ngokuncane.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf hiː wɜːr hɪr, hiː wʊd hæv sɑːlvd ðə ˈprɑːbləm ˈiːzəli/

common_error.wrong: If I would have known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct: If I had known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct_alt: Had I known, I would have told you.
common_error.explanation: Lolu yinto eyenzeka kakhulu ngabantu abashiZulu ngenxa yokuthi ngesiZulu sithi 'Uma ngabe ngiyazi', kodwa ngesiNgisi isimo asiyithathi 'would' ngenkathi. E-if-clause (umthombo) siyathusa 'past perfect' ngaphandle kwe-'would'. Ukuba ufuna ukuyekela, khumbula ukuthi 'would' buyavela nje e-main clause (iphumo). Ungasebenzisa noma uhambo olungaphakathi ngaphandle kwe-'if' ne-verb kuqaleni: 'Had I known...'.

levels.label: Mixed Conditional Type 1: Past Condition, Present Result
levels.translation: I-Conditional Ezimiswe Uhlu 1: Isimo Somandulo, Iphumla Yamahora

examples.original: If I had taken that job, I would be living in Madrid now.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd ˈteɪkən ðæt dʒɒb, aɪ wʊd biː ˈlɪvɪŋ ɪn məˈdrɪd naʊ/
examples.translation: Uma ngabe ngamukele umsebenzi lo, ngabe ngisaphila eMadrid ngoku.
examples.note: Isimo yimandulo (had taken) neziphumo zamahora (would be living). NgisiZulu siyathusa umthelela we-subjunctive e-past perfect esimweni ne-conditional eziphumeni.

examples.original: If we hadn't argued, we would still be friends.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː ˈhædənt ˈɑːrɡjuːd, wiː wʊd stɪl biː frendz/
examples.note: Ukusebenzisa i-'still' (ngoku) kunzima kule uhlu lwe-conditional ezimiswe ukuze kukhombise ukuthi iphumo isahlala ngoku.

levels.label: Mixed Conditional Type 2: Present Condition, Past Result
levels.translation: I-Conditional Ezimiswe Uhlu 2: Isimo Samahora, Iphumla Yamandulo

examples.original: If I were more careful, I wouldn't have made that mistake.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr mɔːr ˈkerfəl, aɪ ˈwʊdənt hæv meɪd ðæt mɪˈsteɪk/
examples.translation: Uma ngingabe ngingowenu, angabe ngenze leyo yimbi.
examples.note: Isimo yamahora (if I were) neziphumo zamandulo (wouldn't have made). Buka ukuthi siyathusa 'were' ngabantu bonke esimweni, nakuba yisendlela esingahambelani.

examples.original: If she spoke English better, she would have understood the movie.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃiː spoʊk ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈbetər, ʃiː wʊd hæv ˌʌndərˈstʊd ðə ˈmuːvi/
examples.translation: Uma yena engabe esikhuluma isiNgisi ngokuhle, ngabe esekuqonda ifilimu.
examples.note: Siyathusa 'if + simple past' esimweni (amahora) ne-'would have + past participle' eziphumeni (amandulo). NgisiZulu, zonke izihloko zisebenzisa umthelela we-subjunctive/conditional.

examples.original: Had I known about the meeting, I would be there now.
examples.phonetic: /hæd aɪ noʊn əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ, aɪ wʊd biː ðer naʊ/
examples.translation: Uma ngabe ngiyazi ngomhlangano, ngabe ngaphandle ngoku.
examples.note: Ukuphinda ngaphandle kwe-'if' kunzima kwaye kusebenziswa ngokuningi e-context zokubhala okanye e-academic. Kule ndaba, isimo yimandulo neziphumo zamahora.

examples.original: Were I in your position, I would have accepted the offer.
examples.phonetic: /wɜːr aɪ ɪn jɔːr pəˈzɪʃən, aɪ wʊd hæv əkˈseptɪd ði ˈɒfər/
examples.note: Ukuziphinda 'Were I...' yisilinganiso se-'If I were...' kusebenziswa ukuze kubhalwe ngendlela efanele. Le uhambo uyalingana nekuphinda 'Had I...'.

examples.original: If you hadn't lied, we would trust you now.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf juː ˈhædənt laɪd, wiː wʊd trʌst juː naʊ/
examples.translation: Uma ungabe ulambile, ngoku besingakholwa nguwe.
examples.note: Lesi sibonelo sikhombisa ukusebenzisa okuningi: ukukhombisa izenzo zamandulo neziphumo zamahora. I-'trust' e-simple present emva kwe-'would' iyofanele ngenxa yokuthi idonsa isimo esijwayelekile.

title: Advanced Passive Voice: Gerunds, Infinitives, and Modals / Izilimi ezindlala: Izincazelo, Izincazelo kanye Nezifanekiso
bridge: NgisiZulu, izilimi ezindlala zidakwa ngokuvamile ngokuthi 'to be + past participle' futhi kunzima ukuzisebenzisa nezincazelo ezingezihlobo (gerund/infinitive). NgesiNgisi, izilimi ezindlala zinekhono lokuhlula: ungahola 'must be done', 'being done', 'to be done', njll. Phutha oluningi yikuthi ukuhlinzeka kwezihlobo zesiSpane ngokwengeziwe, njengokuthi 'debe ser hecho' esikhundleni se- 'has to be done'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngesiNgisi umsebenzi uyakhiwa ngokuvamile (awusho 'by someone' uma akungekhona isilinganiso), ngakho-ke ngesiSpane siyayithatha kangcono.
rule: NgesiNgisi, izilimi ezindlala ezindlala zidakwa ngesilimi 'to be' ngeziggiyo ezinye izikhathi, izincazelo okanye izinhlobo ezingezihlobo, eselandelwa yisicazulo esedlule. Ngokwamazisi: isicazulo + be + past participle (njl. 'must be done', 'can be seen'). Ngokwezincazelo: to be + past participle (njl. 'to be considered'). Ngokwezincazelo: being + past participle (njl. 'being watched'). Ngezincazelo eziqondile: isicazulo + have been + past participle (njl. 'should have been informed'). Kunanjalo nezilimi ezindlala ezinomthelela: 'This chair was sat on' (ngitshoni kancane). Qaphela izilimi ezingazisebenzisi izilimi ezindlala (ezingaphakathi) kanye nokushiywa komsebenzi: uma akuningi, kushiwa.

concept_examples.text: The report must be submitted by Friday.
concept_examples.translation: Umbhalo uyadingeka ukuthi ufakele ngosuku lweGqunye.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈpɔːrt mʌst biː səbˈmɪtɪd baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/

concept_examples.text: She enjoys being photographed.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪnˈdʒɔɪz ˈbiːɪŋ ˈfoʊtəɡræft/

concept_examples.text: The problem needs to be solved immediately.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈprɑːbləm niːdz tə biː sɒlvd ɪˈmiːdiətli/

concept_examples.text: The package could have been delivered yesterday.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈpækɪdʒ kʊd hæv biːn dɪˈlɪvərd ˈjestərdeɪ/

common_error.wrong: The problem must be solved *by us* immediately. (cuando no es necesario el agente)
common_error.correct: The problem must be solved immediately.
common_error.correct_alt: The problem has to be solved immediately.
common_error.explanation: Abantu abashiSpane bayengena ngokuvamile ukubeka umsebenzi 'by someone' ngenxa yokuthi ngesiSpane kunzima ukubeka 'por nosotros' okanye 'por alguien'. NgesiNgisi, uma umsebenzi uyaziwayo okanye akunengi, ushiwa ukuze kube khona ukuqondwa. Inye isahluko yikuthi 'has to be solved', eyisahluko esihle kangcono. Hamba phambili ukungena kwemininingwane eyingozi.

examples.original: The rules can be changed.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ruːlz kæn biː tʃeɪndʒd/
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'can be' ukubeka ukunikezwa. NgesiSpane ngazinikeza 'se pueden cambiar'.

examples.original: The application must be completed before noon.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃən mʌst biː kəmˈpliːtɪd bɪˈfɔːr nuːn/
examples.translation: Isicelo sidinga ukuthi sifakwe ngaphambi kwephambili.
examples.note: 'Must be' kubeka ukubeka. NgesiSpane siyayithatha 'debe + infinitivo'.

examples.original: This issue should be addressed immediately.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈɪʃuː ʃʊd biː əˈdrest ɪˈmiːdiətli/
examples.translation: Inkinga le yi dinga ukuthi ithatwe ngokukhawuleza.
examples.note: 'Should be' ukubeka ukubekwa. Qaphela ukukhuluma kwe- 'should'.

examples.original: The meeting may be postponed if necessary.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ meɪ biː poʊstˈpoʊnd ɪf ˈnesəseri/
examples.note: 'May be' ukubeka ukunikezwa. NgesiSpane siyayithatha 'puede ser'.

levels.label: Passive Gerunds and Infinitives
levels.translation: Izincazelo kanye nezinye izincazelo ezihlobene nezilimi ezindlala

examples.original: He dislikes being told what to do.
examples.phonetic: /hiː dɪsˈlaɪks ˈbiːɪŋ toʊld wɒt tə duː/
examples.note: NgesiSpane siyayithatha 'que le digan', ngakho-ke ngesiNgisi siyayithatha isicazulo esihlobene nezilimi ezindlala 'being told'.

examples.original: She is proud to be selected for the team.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪz praʊd tə biː sɪˈlektɪd fɔːr ðə tiːm/
examples.note: Isicazulo esihlobene nezilimi ezindlala 'to be selected' siyayithatha 'ser seleccionada' ngesiSpane.

examples.original: The data needs to be analyzed carefully.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈdeɪtə niːdz tə biː ˈænəlaɪzd ˈkerfəli/
examples.note: 'Needs to be' + past participle. NgesiSpane siyayithatha 'necesita ser'.

examples.original: He admitted to being involved in the incident.
examples.phonetic: /hiː ədˈmɪtɪd tə ˈbiːɪŋ ɪnˈvɒlvd ɪn ðə ˈɪnsɪdənt/
examples.note: Isicazulo esihlobene nezilimi ezindlala 'being involved' siyayithatha 'estar implicado' ngesiSpane.

levels.label: Passive with Perfect Modals and Reporting Verbs
levels.translation: Izilimi ezindlala ezinomthelela kanye nezinye izilimi eziqondile

examples.original: The thief might have been caught by the police.
examples.phonetic: /ðə θiːf maɪt hæv biːn kɔːt baɪ ðə pəˈliːs/
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'might have been' ukubeka ukubekwa kwesikhathi esidlulile. NgesiSpane: 'podria haber sido'.

examples.original: The documents should have been signed yesterday.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɒkjumənts ʃʊd hæv biːn saɪnd ˈjestərdeɪ/
examples.note: Kubeka ukubekwa kwezinga ezingezifunwanga esikhathini esidlulile. NgesiSpane: 'deberian haber sido'.

examples.original: The president is said to be considering new policies.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈprezɪdənt ɪz sed tə biː kənˈsɪdərɪŋ nuː ˈpɒləsiz/
examples.translation: Kusho ukuthi umongameli uyacenga izinhlelo ezintsha.
examples.note: Isimo esisebenzisa isilimi esiqondile: 'is said to be' + gerund. NgesiSpane siyayithatha 'se dice que'.

examples.original: The lost city is believed to have been discovered in 2015.
examples.phonetic: /ðə lɒst ˈsɪti ɪz bɪˈliːvd tə hæv biːn dɪˈskʌvərd ɪn tuː ˈθaʊzənd ənd fɪfˈtiːn/
examples.translation: Kholwa ukuthi idolophu elidilile lidluliswe ngo-2015.
examples.note: Isilimi esindlala esisebenzisa 'be believed to + have been + past participle' ukubeka izinkombiso eziqondile.

translations.zu: Izilimi ezindlala: Izincazelo, Izincazelo kanye Nezifanekiso

title: Advanced Reported Speech / Isibonelo esiqondene esikhulunywa ngokwasendaweni
bridge: Ngesi, lapho sihambelela isibonelo esikhulunywa ngokwasendaweni, sivamise isikhathi somshalo njengaso esihlahla uma umshalo oqala ngesikhathi esimisa, kodwa ngesiNgisi kudingeka ukubuyiselwa kwesikhathi (ukubuyiselwa kwesikhathi) uma umshalo oqala ngesikhathi esidlulile: 'She says she is tired' vs. 'She said she was tired'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngesiNgisi ukuguqulwa kwesikhathi kunesimo kunangesi: 'will' siya ku-'would', 'can' ku-'could', futhi amaxesha esedlule ayebuyiselwa (past simple → past perfect). Inye into ephuza kakhulu yikuthi ngesiNgisi awusetshenzwa isubjunctive ezikhombisweni eziphawulweyo njengangesi ('Dijo que viniera' → 'He said to come' okanye 'He said that I should come'), futhi amazwi okuhlola isikhathi nesindawo aguqulwa ngendlela eziphambili (today → that day, here → there).
rule:
Ngokwesibonelo esiqondene esikhulunywa ngokwasendaweni ngesiNgisi (eyiveli laseB2):
1. **Ukubuyiselwa kwesikhathi**: Uma umshalo oqala ngesikhathi esidlulile (said, told, asked), isikhathi somshalo ezikhombisweni iyabuyiselwa ngasenyakatho: present simple → past simple; present continuous → past continuous; past simple → past perfect; present perfect → past perfect; will → would; can → could; may → might; must → had to (okanye must uma kulinganiselwe ukudinga).
2. **Akukho ukubuyiselwa kwesikhathi**: Akukho ukubuyiselwa kwesikhathi uma isithembiso siyamisa okanye sinomthelela ngesikhathi sokukhuluma (nakuba kusingeke): 'He said he is ill' (uyaphuzile) okanye 'He said he was ill' (akuseke sidinga).
3. **Ukuguqulwa kwabazithombeli nabo bonke**: Ukulungiswa ngokomqondo: 'I' → 'he/she', 'my' → 'his/her', nabo bonke.
4. **Ukuguqulwa kwamazwi okuhlola isikhathi nesindawo**: today → that day; yesterday → the day before / the previous day; tomorrow → the next day / the following day; here → there; now → then.
5. **Imibuzo ephawulwe**: Ukuhlobo luyaguqulwa kuqhubeka futhi kusetshenzwa 'if/whether' kumaqhubeka/nga, futhi igama elibuza kumaqhubeka okuvula. Awusetshenzwa isikhuthazi 'do/does/did': 'Where does he live?' → 'She asked where he lived.'
6. **Izilathiso nezicelo**: Kusetshenzwa 'tell/ask + isibonelo + infinitive': 'He told me to close the door.' Awusetshenzwa 'that'.
7. **Amashalo okuqhubeka**: 'would', 'could', 'might', 'should', 'ought to' awaguquli. 'must' liyakuma okanye liyabuyiselwa ku-'had to' ngokomqondo.

concept_examples.text: She said she had finished the report the day before.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː sed ʃiː hæd ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə rɪˈpɔːrt ðə deɪ bɪˈfɔːr/

concept_examples.text: He asked if I could help him with the project.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː æskt ɪf aɪ kʊd hɛlp hɪm wɪð ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt/

concept_examples.text: They told us to wait outside.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ toʊld ʌs tə weɪt ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/

concept_examples.text: She warned that the meeting might be postponed.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː wɔːrnd ðæt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ maɪt biː poʊstˈpoʊnd/

common_error.wrong: She said me that she was tired.
common_error.correct: She told me that she was tired.
common_error.correct_alt: She said that she was tired.
common_error.explanation: Ngesi, 'decir' kusetshenzwa nobunye obudla (me dijo), kodwa ngesiNgisi 'say' akusetshenzwa nobunye obudla; kusetshenzwa 'tell' uma kuhlobelwe lowo othwele. Ngakho-ke, 'said me' akusiyo; kusetshenzwa 'told me' okanye 'said' bengakunobunye.

examples.original: Paul said he was going to London the following day.
examples.phonetic: /pɔːl sɛd hiː wɒz ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə ˈlʌndən ðə ˈfɒləʊɪŋ deɪ/
examples.translation: UPaul wathi wayehamba eLondon ngosuku olulandele.
examples.note: Buka ukubuyiselwa kwesikhathi: 'is going' → 'was going' futhi 'tomorrow' → 'the following day'.

examples.original: She mentioned she had already seen that film.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈmɛnʃənd ʃiː hæd ɔːlˈrɛdi siːn ðæt fɪlm/
examples.note: I-present perfect 'have seen' iyabuyiselwa ku-past perfect 'had seen'.

examples.original: They claimed they would finish the project by Friday.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ kleɪmd ðeɪ wʊd ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/
examples.translation: Bathanda ukuthi bazokugcwalisa iprojekthi ngosuku lweFriday.
examples.note: 'Will' siya ku-'would' esiboneni esikhulunywa ngokwasendaweni.

examples.original: She asked where the nearest bank was.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː æskt wɛə ðə ˈnɪərɪst bæŋk wɒz/
examples.note: Ezimibuzweni eziphawulweyo, uhlobo luyabhubha: 'was' ngesiphephelo, hhayi 'was the bank'.

examples.original: He wondered if she had received his email.
examples.phonetic: /hiː ˈwʌndərd ɪf ʃiː hæd rɪˈsiːvd hɪz ˈiːmeɪl/
examples.translation: Wabuza ukuthi ingane yabo yathamela yini imvule yabo.
examples.note: Kumaqhubeka okuqhubeka/nga kusetshenzwa 'if' okanye 'whether'.

examples.original: They asked us why we hadn't called earlier.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ æskt ʌs waɪ wiː ˈhædnt kɔːld ˈɜːrliər/
examples.translation: Babuza ukuthi singabiza yini ngaphambi kwalokho.
examples.note: Ibizo elihlahla 'Why didn't you call?' liyabuyiselwa ku-'why we hadn't called'.

levels.label: Reported Commands, Requests and Suggestions
levels.translation: Izilathiso, izicelo nezicelo esiboneni esikhulunywa ngokwasendaweni

examples.original: The teacher told us to stop talking.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈtiːtʃər toʊld ʌs tə stɒp ˈtɔːkɪŋ/
examples.note: Sethenjwa 'tell + isibonelo + infinitive' kuzo izilathiso.

examples.original: She asked me to open the window.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː æskt miː tə ˈəʊpən ðə ˈwɪndəʊ/
examples.note: Kuzo izicelo kusetshenzwa 'ask + isibonelo + infinitive'.

examples.original: He suggested going to the cinema.
examples.phonetic: /hiː səˈdʒɛstɪd ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə ðə ˈsɪnəmə/
examples.note: Kuzo izicelo, kungasetshenzwa igerundive (suggest + -ing) okanye 'that + should'.

examples.original: She recommended that we book early.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˌrɛkəˈmɛndɪd ðæt wiː bʊk ˈɜːrli/
examples.note: Nge-'recommend' kungasetshenzwa 'that + isikhathi' nesikhathi somshalo esihlahla (subjunctive).

title: Inversion for Emphasis / Ukubuyiselwa kwesibonelo
bridge: Ngesi, ukuze sisize ukukhuluma ngokucacile, siyathanda ukusebenzisa ukukhuluma okucacile noma ukubuyiselwa kwamazwi ngokuhlala nokulula ("Ngazima-ke angibonanga into enjalo"). Ngesinga, kepha, lapho amazwi athandweni okungakithi noma okungakithiyo (rarely, not only, never, etc.) awekwa ekuqaleni kwesibonelo, kudingeka ukubuyiselwa kwesibonelo nokusebenza kwesibonelo, njengokuba kunjalo emibuzweni. Lokhu kubuyiselwa akukho ukukhetha: uma ungakwenzanga, isibonelo siyabona ngokufana nokuthi singakwazi ukukhuluma ngokufanayo nge-English. Umphutha othile owenza umuntu ongu-Spanish ukungakwazi ukukhuluma ngokufanayo nge-English ngoba akukho ukubuyiselwa kwesibonelo nge-Spanish.
rule: Ukubuyiselwa kwesibonelo kwezikhamuzi noma ukubuyiselwa kwesibonelo kwezikhamuzi kwehlu lakho lokukhuluma, lapho isibonelo noma isibonelo esisebenziswa ngokucacile noma ngokungakithi, sisebenzisa ukubuyiselwa kwesibonelo. Izibonelo ezingcono kakhulu ziyo: never, rarely, seldom, hardly ever, not only, no sooner, little, under no circumstances, at no time, in no way. Isibonelo siyabona ngokufana nokuthi singakwazi ukukhuluma ngokufanayo nge-English: [Isibonelo esingakithi/esikhamuzi] + isibonelo (do/does/did, have/has, will, can, etc.) + isibonelo + isibonelo esikhulu. Uma akukho isibonelo, siyakwenza 'do' ngesikhathi esihle noma 'did' ngesikhathi esidlulile (ngaphandle kwesibonelo 'to be', esibuyiselwa ngokucacile). Ngesibonelo 'not only' siyathanda ukusebenzisa ukubuyiselwa kwesibonelo kwisibonelo esokuqala: "Not only did she sing, but she also danced". Ngesibonelo 'no sooner' siyathanda ukusebenzisa isibonelo esidlulile: "No sooner had we arrived than it started raining". Lokhu kwehlu lakho lokukhuluma okungakithi noma okungakithi, kepha kuhlukile nge-English.

concept_examples.text: Not only did she finish the project, but she also presented it brilliantly.
concept_examples.translation: Akusiyo kuphela ukuthi usekelwe umsebenzi, kepha waboniswa ngokucacile.
concept_examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈəʊnli dɪd ʃiː ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə ˈprɒdʒekt bʌt ʃiː ˈɔːlsəʊ prɪˈzentɪd ɪt ˈbrɪliəntli/

concept_examples.text: Rarely do we see such dedication in our team.
concept_examples.translation: Rara sikhona ukubona ukusebenza okunjalo kwabantu basebenzi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈreəli duː wiː siː sʌtʃ ˌdedɪˈkeɪʃn ɪn ˈaʊə tiːm/

concept_examples.text: Never have I encountered a more challenging problem.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈnevə hæv aɪ ɪnˈkaʊntəd ə mɔː ˈtʃælɪndʒɪŋ ˈprɒbləm/

concept_examples.text: Under no circumstances should you disclose this information.
concept_examples.translation: Ngaphandle kwesikhathi esingakithi, akusiyo mfanelo ukubeka ulwazi olunjalo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈʌndə nəʊ ˈsɜːkəmstænsɪz ʃʊd juː dɪsˈkləʊz ðɪs ˌɪnfəˈmeɪʃn/

common_error.wrong: Rarely we see such beautiful sunsets.
common_error.correct: Rarely do we see such beautiful sunsets.
common_error.correct_alt: We rarely see such beautiful sunsets.
common_error.explanation: Umphutha uyavela ngoba nge-Spanish "Rara sikhona..." kuhlukile ukubuyiselwa kwesibonelo, futhi umfundi uyahlulela ngokucacile. Nge-English, lapho isibonelo esingakithi sisebenzisa isibonelo, kudingeka ukubuyiselwa kwesibonelo nesibonelo 'do' (ngesikhathi esihle). Indlela yokunguquka ngaphandle kwesibonelo iyeyokubeka isibonelo emva kwesibonelo ("We rarely see..."), eyinhlobo eyathi kakhulu nge-English. Ukuze uqhubeke ukuphula umphutha, khumbula: uma isibonelo sisebenzisa isibonelo, kudingeka ukubuyiselwa; uma ungathandi ukubuyiselwa, beka isibonelo endaweni eyinye.

examples.original: Never have I been so happy.
examples.phonetic: /ˈnevə hæv aɪ biːn səʊ ˈhæpi/
examples.note: Kusetshenziswa 'have' njengesibonelo ngoba isibonelo esihle sisidinga isibonelo. Nge-Spanish, 'nunca' sikhona ukubeka phambi kwesibonelo ngaphandle kokubuyiselwa kwesibonelo.

examples.original: Hardly ever does he arrive on time.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhɑːdli ˈevə dʌz hiː əˈraɪv ɒn taɪm/
examples.note: Bona ukuthi nge-'he' (umuntu owesithathu) isibonelo iyeyo 'does', hhayi 'do'.

examples.original: Little did we know about the plan.
examples.phonetic: /ˈlɪtəl dɪd wiː nəʊ əˈbaʊt ðə plæn/
examples.note: Isibonelo 'little' esisebenziswa njengesibonelo esingakithi (okuncane) siyakwenza ukubuyiselwa kwesibonelo. Nge-Spanish siyabiza 'poco sabíamos' ngaphandle kokubuyiselwa kwesibonelo.

examples.original: Not only did they win the match, but they also broke the record.
examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈəʊnli dɪd ðeɪ wɪn ðə mætʃ bʌt ðeɪ ˈɔːlsəʊ brəʊk ðə ˈrekɔːd/
examples.translation: Akusiyo kuphela ukuthi bafumene isibonelo, kepha bafumene isibonelo esikhulu.
examples.note: Ukubuyiselwa kwesibonelo kwehlu lakho lokukhuluma kwisibonelo esokuqala nge-'did'. Isibonelo esilandelayo (but they also) asisebenzisi ukubuyiselwa kwesibonelo.

examples.original: No sooner had the meeting started than the fire alarm went off.
examples.phonetic: /nəʊ ˈsuːnə hæd ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ ˈstɑːtɪd ðæn ðə ˈfaɪər əˈlɑːm went ɒf/
examples.translation: Ngesikhathi esincane-ke sesiqalile ukuhlangana, kwasela ingozi yezibuko.
examples.note: Nge-'no sooner' siyathanda ukusebenzisa isibonelo esidlulile (had + participio) nokubuyiselwa kwesibonelo. Nge-Spanish siyabiza 'apenas' noma 'no bien' ngaphandle kwesibonelo esisebenziswa.

examples.original: Not only is she intelligent, but she is also very creative.
examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈəʊnli ɪz ʃiː ɪnˈtelɪdʒənt bʌt ʃiː ɪz ˈɔːlsəʊ ˈveri kriˈeɪtɪv/
examples.translation: Akusiyo kuphela ukuthi ungumfundi, kepha ungumfundi omkhulu.
examples.note: Nge-'to be' ukubuyiselwa kwesibonelo kwehlu lakho lokukhuluma: isibonelo siyabeka phambi kwesibonelo ngaphandle kwesibonelo 'do'.

levels.label: Advanced Inversion with Negative Prepositional Phrases
levels.translation: Ukubuyiselwa okwengeziwe kwesibonelo esisebenziswa ngokufanayo nge-English

examples.original: Under no circumstances should you open that door.
examples.phonetic: /ˈʌndə nəʊ ˈsɜːkəmstænsɪz ʃʊd juː ˈəʊpən ðæt dɔː/
examples.translation: Ngaphandle kwesikhathi esingakithi, akusiyo mfanelo ukuvula umnyango.
examples.note: Lokhu kwehlu lakho lokukhuluma okungakithi futhi kuhlukile nge-English, ukubeka izibonelo, ukubeka izibonelo noma ukukhuluma. Nge-Spanish siyabiza 'bajo ninguna circunstancia debes...' ngaphandle kokubuyiselwa kwesibonelo.

examples.original: At no time did the manager admit his mistake.
examples.phonetic: /æt nəʊ taɪm dɪd ðə ˈmænɪdʒər ədˈmɪt hɪz mɪˈsteɪk/
examples.translation: Ngesikhathi esingakithi, umphakathi akavumanga ukuphula umphutha wakhe.
examples.note: Isibonelo 'at no time' sisidinga ukubuyiselwa kwesibonelo nge-'did' ngesikhathi esidlulile. Nge-Spanish, ukubeka 'en ningún momento' kuhlukile kakhulu.

examples.original: In no way can we accept such a proposal.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn nəʊ weɪ kæn wiː əkˈsept sʌtʃ ə prəˈpəʊzl/
examples.note: Nokho, kuhlukile ukusebenzisa amavesi njengokuthi 'can', 'could', 'should'. Ukubuyiselwa kwesibonelo kwehlu lakho lokukhuluma.

examples.original: Seldom have I seen such a magnificent performance.
examples.phonetic: /ˈseldəm hæv aɪ siːn sʌtʃ ə mæɡˈnɪfɪsənt pəˈfɔːməns/
examples.note: 'Seldom' iyinhlobo yesi-'rarely' kepha iyesi-English kakhulu. Nge-Spanish siyathanda ukusebenzisa 'rara vez' noma 'raramente' ngaphandle kokubuyiselwa kwesibonelo.

title: Cleft sentences (It is/was... that) / Izigaqulalo ezindlifile
bridge: Ngesi, ukuze siphakamise umthelela, siyahlala sizisa izinhlelo njengokuthi 'Fue Juan quien lo hizo' okanye 'Es aquí donde vivo'. NgesiNgisi, kudakhiwe ngokuthi 'it' + isivumelwano 'to be' + umthelela ophanekayo + 'that/who' + isahluko esingasemuva komsebenzi. Uphuthu oluningi yikuthi ngesiNgisi, umlomo 'it' uyadingeka (awunakho ukushiywa), futhi umthelela 'that' ungasintha ku- 'who' abantu, kodwa awunakho ukusebenzisa 'which' kulomuhla. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ukuxhumana koma ayisidingo kakhulu kungesi, lapho singahlela ukususa isivumelwano ngenhlamba enkulu.
rule: Izigaqulalo ezindlifile (cleft sentences) zisebenzisa ukwenza umthelela ophanekayo esihlokweni esiphakeme somsebenzi. Isimo esijwayelekile yikuthi: 'It' + isivumelwano 'to be' (ngosuku lwanamuhla okanye ngesikhathi esidlulile) + umthelela ophanekayo (umsebenzi, into, isikhathi sokulandela, indawo, n.a.) + umlomo ongaselwa ('that', 'who', 'whom', 'whose') + isahluko esingasemuva komsebenzi. Abantu, kungasebenziswe 'who' (umsebenzi) okanye 'whom' (into, noma ngokomthelela). Izinto ngezinto, 'that' (okanye 'which' ngokomthelela ophanekayo). Ngosuku lwanamuhla kusetshenziswa 'is', ngesikhathi esidlulile 'was'. Awusebenzisi 'it's' ngesikhathi esidlulile (akusiyo), kusetshenziswa 'it was'. Umthelela ophanekayo ungasaba ngokuba yisibhalo, umlomo, isihloko esisodwa okanye isigaqulalo. Isibonelo: 'It was Maria who called me.' / 'It is the weekend that I enjoy the most.' / 'It was in Paris that we met.' / 'It is because of you that I came.' Kunanini nezihloko ezinye nge- 'what' (what-clauses): 'What I need is a coffee.' Kulomuhla, awusebenzisi 'it' njengomsebenzi, kodwa 'what' ekuqaleni. Ezinye izinhlelo: 'The reason why...', 'The thing that...', 'The person who...', kodwa ezijwayelekile kakhulu yikale 'it' ne- 'what'. Izimpawu: awusebenzisi 'it' lapho umthelela ophanekayo uselekweni (kusetshenziswa isimo esingasemuva njengokuthi 'what...do'). Ezinye izinto, kusetshenziswa 'It wasn't...' okanye 'It isn't...'.

concept_examples.text: It was John who broke the window.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt wɒz dʒɒn huː brəʊk ðə ˈwɪndəʊ/

concept_examples.text: It is the weather that affects my mood.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ðə ˈweðər ðæt əˈfekts maɪ muːd/

concept_examples.text: It was in 2005 that they got married.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt wɒz ɪn tuː ˈθaʊzənd ənd faɪv ðæt ðeɪ ɡɒt ˈmærid/

concept_examples.text: What I really need is a holiday.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wɒt aɪ ˈrɪəli niːd ɪz ə ˈhɒlədeɪ/

common_error.wrong: Fue Juan que rompió la ventana.
common_error.correct: It was John who broke the window.
common_error.correct_alt: It was John that broke the window.
common_error.explanation: Impawu eyinhloko yikuthi ukuhumusha ngokomthelela ophanekayo 'Fue Juan que...' futhi ukushiya umlomo 'it' ngesiNgisi. NgesiNgisi, isimo isidinga umsebenzi 'it' ekuqaleni. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngesi siyahlala sizisa 'que' abantu ngezinto, kodwa ngesiNgisi abantu bayafisa 'who' (noma 'that' nayiphi na, 'who' iyabalulekile kakhulu). Kuyadingeka ukukhumbula ukuthi isivumelwano 'to be' siyahambisana ngesikhathi nomuntu: 'is' ngosuku lwanamuhla, 'was' ngesikhathi esidlulile, ngesikhathi esidlulile 'was' no- 'it' (akusiyo: 'It is was'). Ukuze ukuvikeleke, dinga ukudakhiwa kwesigaqulalo no- 'it' + 'be' + umthelela ophanekayo + 'who/that'.

examples.original: It is my sister who knows the secret.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz maɪ ˈsɪstər huː nəʊz ðə ˈsiːkrɪt/
examples.note: Sisetshenzisa 'who' abantu, kungasebenziswe 'that' nayiphi na.

examples.original: It was the noise that woke me up.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt wɒz ðə nɔɪz ðæt wəʊk miː ʌp/
examples.note: Izinto, 'that' (okanye 'which' ngokomthelela ophanekayo, kodwa 'that' iyabalulekile kakhulu).

examples.original: It was your mother who called earlier.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt wɒz jɔː ˈmʌðər huː kɔːld ˈɜːliər/
examples.note: Khumbula ukuxhumana: it + was + umthelela + who + isahluko.

levels.label: Cleft sentences with time, place and reason

examples.original: It is in autumn that the leaves fall.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɪn ˈɔːtəm ðæt ðə liːvz fɔːl/
examples.translation: Ngesikhathi esidlulile ngesihhashi lapho kwehla amathambo.
examples.note: Ngesikhathi, asisebenzisi 'when' ezigaqulalweni ezindlifile, kodwa 'that'.

examples.original: It was at the station that we said goodbye.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt wɒz æt ðə ˈsteɪʃən ðæt wiː sed ɡʊdˈbaɪ/
examples.note: Nge-indawo, sisetshenzisa 'that' (hha 'where' ezigaqulalweni no- 'it').

examples.original: It is because of the rain that the match was cancelled.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz bɪˈkɒz əv ðə reɪn ðæt ðə mætʃ wɒz ˈkænsəld/
examples.note: Nge-mthelela, 'because of' + 'that'.

examples.original: What I want is a new car.
examples.phonetic: /wɒt aɪ wɒnt ɪz ə njuː kɑːr/
examples.note: Isimo 'what + isigaqulalo' + 'be' + umthelela ophanekayo. Awusebenzisi 'it'.

examples.original: What she did was apologize.
examples.phonetic: /wɒt ʃiː dɪd wɒz əˈpɒlədʒaɪz/
examples.note: Uma umthelela ophanekayo uselekweni, kusetshenziswa 'what' + 'do' + 'be' + isivumelwano esingakhiwe.

examples.original: The reason why I left is that I was tired.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈriːzən waɪ aɪ left ɪz ðæt aɪ wɒz ˈtaɪəd/
examples.note: Ukufaka 'the reason why' njengensibido.

title: Nominalisation: Turning Verbs and Adjectives into Nouns / Ukunomisha: Ukushintsha Amavhesi namanzi kwezihloko
bridge: Ngisi-Ngisi, ukunomisha kukhona ngokuvamile ezihlobonini zasefomula nakwabafundisi: kukhona ukuthandwa kwe- 'the discovery of' esikhundleni se- 'they discovered'. Ngokungalinzanga isi-Spanish, lapho kukhona ukusetshenziswa okuningi kwe-infinitive njengesiqalo (el descubrir), isi-Ngisi kusetshenzisa amasufiksi njengokuthi -tion, -ment, -ness. Qaphela: akazozo zonke izivhesi enesihlokothulo enomlinganiselo wokuthi enomlinganiswo, futhi umwebo wamazwi uyashintsha: ngisi-Ngisi isekelwe (okanye 'of') isesabantu, ngesi-Spanish kusetshenziswa 'de' emva kwaso.
rule:
Kuze kufike e-B2, dula la mazizi: 
1. Izivhesi → izihlokothulo nezamasufiksi: -tion (inform → information), -ment (develop → development), -ance/-ence (perform → performance), -al (approve → approval), -ure (fail → failure).
2. Amanzi → izihlokothulo: -ness (happy → happiness), -ity (active → activity), -th (strong → strength), -ce (important → importance).
3. Izinhlelo ezingasekho: choose → choice, believe → belief, prove → proof, lose → loss.
4. Ukufaka: ngisi-Ngisi efomula kukhona ukuthandwa kwe- 'the implementation of the plan' esikhundleni se- 'they implemented the plan'. Nge- 'make' + isihlokothulo: 'make a decision' esikhundleni se- 'decide'.
5. Izimpawu: ezinye izivhesi azishintshi (change → change), futhi ezinye izihlokothulo zinebangiso ezakhiwe (relation vs. relationship).

concept_examples.text: The discovery of penicillin changed medicine.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə dɪˈskʌvəri əv ˌpɛnɪˈsɪlɪn tʃeɪndʒd ˈmɛdɪsɪn/

concept_examples.text: Her happiness was obvious to everyone.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hɜːr ˈhæpinəs wɒz ˈɒbviəs tə ˈɛvrɪwʌn/

concept_examples.text: The development of new technologies is rapid.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə dɪˈvɛləpmənt əv njuː tɛkˈnɒlədʒiz ɪz ˈræpɪd/

concept_examples.text: We need a decision by tomorrow.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː niːd ə dɪˈsɪʒən baɪ təˈmɒroʊ/

common_error.wrong: The discovery of the new planet was made by NASA.
common_error.correct: The discovery of the new planet was made by NASA.
common_error.explanation: Lesibonelo lesi siphila; ngempela, umphutha othile ngokuvamile ukusetshenzisa ivhesi lapho kukhona ukulinda kwesihlokothulo: 'They discovered the new planet' ekufomuleni esikhundleni se- 'The discovery of the new planet...'. Abantu abakhuluma isi-Spanish ngokuvamile bayahlela ngokwedlula 'el descubrir' okanye besebenzisa ivhesi njengesihlokothulo: 'The discovering of...' okungaphili. Ukubeka, funda amasufiksi okunomisha futhi sebenza ukushintsha izinkulumo zavhesi ezihlo kwezihloko.

examples.original: The invention of the internet changed communication.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ɪnˈvɛnʃən əv ði ˈɪntəˌnɛt tʃeɪndʒd kəˌmjuːnɪˈkeɪʃən/
examples.note: Isufiksi -tion ishintsha 'invent' ku- 'invention'. Ngesi-Spanish sinokho -ción, kodwa qaphela ukubhala.

examples.original: His improvement in English was remarkable.
examples.phonetic: /hɪz ɪmˈpruːvmənt ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ wɒz rɪˈmɑːrkəbl/
examples.note: Isufiksi -ment: improve → improvement. Ngesi-Spanish ngokuvamile sisetshenzisa 'mejora' ngaphandle kwesufiksi.

examples.original: The appearance of the actor caused excitement.
examples.phonetic: /ði əˈpɪərəns əv ði ˈæktər kɔːzd ɪkˈsaɪtmənt/
examples.note: Isufiksi -ance: appear → appearance. Ungakhathazi 'apparition' (umoya).

examples.original: Her kindness made everyone feel welcome.
examples.phonetic: /hɜːr ˈkaɪndnəs meɪd ˈɛvrɪwʌn fiːl ˈwɛlkəm/
examples.translation: Ubusisi bakhe bawenza bonke babe nobuntu.
examples.note: Isufiksi -ness: kind → kindness. Ngesi-Spanish ngokuvamile sisetshenzisa '-idad' okanye '-ura'.

examples.original: The importance of education cannot be underestimated.
examples.phonetic: /ði ɪmˈpɔːrtəns əv ˌɛdʒuˈkeɪʃən kænɒt biː ˌʌndərˈɛstɪmeɪtɪd/
examples.note: Isufiksi -ance kumanzi e-ant: important → importance. Qaphela 'e' ekugcineni.

examples.original: She showed great strength in difficult times.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ʃoʊd ɡreɪt strɛŋkθ ɪn ˈdɪfɪkəlt taɪmz/
examples.note: Isufiksi -th: strong → strength. Impawu ezingasekho, ungasetshenzisi '-ness'.

examples.original: The implementation of the new policy was delayed.
examples.phonetic: /ði ˌɪmplɪmɛnˈteɪʃən əv ðə njuː ˈpɒləsi wɒz dɪˈleɪd/
examples.note: Ngesi-Ngisi efomula kukhona ukuthandwa kwe- 'implementation' esikhundleni se- 'they implemented'.

examples.original: There has been an increase in unemployment.
examples.phonetic: /ðɛr hæz biːn ən ˈɪnkriːs ɪn ˌʌnɪmˈplɔɪmənt/
examples.note: Ukufaka kwesihlokothulo nge- 'there has been' + isihlokothulo. Khayela ukuthi 'unemployment has increased' ekufomuleni ekuvile.

examples.original: The failure of the talks led to conflict.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈfeɪljər əv ðə tɔːks lɛd tə ˈkɒnflɪkt/
examples.note: Ivhesi elingasekho: fail → failure. Ungasho 'the failing'.

title: Advanced Modal Verbs: Would Have, Should Have, etc. / Izi-Modal Ezikhulu: would have, should have, etc.
bridge: NgisiZulu, siye sakha la madotshizi ngokusebenzisa isicono sokuqeda (bengizokwenza, bengingakwenza) noma isicono sokudla. Kodwa, ngesiNgisi, kuhlanganiswa izimodi (would, should, could, might) no- 'have' kanye ne-past participle. Isahluko esibalulekile yikuthi ngisiZulu siyasebenza 'kuba' + isicathulo, kodwa ngesiNgisi isivamisi yimodi + 'have' + isicathulo. Qaphela: 'would have' asisho 'bengizokuba' ngokwenhlamba, kodwa kuveza umsebenzi owakhiwe ngokwesiqotho esidulungile.
rule: Kudalaniswa ngomodi (would, should, could, might, must) + 'have' + past participle. Kusetshenziswa ukukhuluma ngemihlo ebingeziwe ngokwesiqotho (would have), izilathiso ezingalandelwayo noma ukukhombisa (should have), izindlela ezingezikhona (could have, might have), kanye nezingqikitho ngokwesiqotho (must have). Ngokungenasidingo, 'not' iyabekwa emva komodi (should not have / shouldn't have). Emibuzweni, isibhalo siyaguqulwa (Would you have...?). Izilathiso ezisebenzayo: would've, should've, could've. Isikhala: 'must have' asisetshenziswa ukudonsa izinto ezingekho (kusetshenziswa 'couldn't have' noma 'was not allowed to').

concept_examples.text: I would have called you, but I lost your number.
concept_examples.translation: Bengizokuxhumana nawe, kodwa ngisile ngenhloso yalakho.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd hæv kɔːld juː bʌt aɪ lɔːst jɔːr ˈnʌmbər/

concept_examples.text: You should have studied more for the exam.
concept_examples.translation: Kwabe kwakudinga ukuba ufunde kabanzi ngenye icala lokuhlola.
concept_examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd hæv ˈstʌdid mɔːr fɔːr ði ɪɡˈzæm/

concept_examples.text: She could have become a doctor, but she chose art.
concept_examples.translation: Ngekhe bekungokuba yindokotshi, kodwa yakhetha umzobo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː kʊd hæv bɪˈkʌm ə ˈdɒktər bʌt ʃiː tʃuːz ɑːrt/

concept_examples.text: They must have missed the train; they're not here yet.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ mʌst hæv mɪst ðə treɪn ðeər nɒt hɪər jet/

common_error.wrong: I would have called you, but I losed your number.
common_error.correct: I would have called you, but I lost your number.
common_error.correct_alt: I would have called you, but I had lost your number.
common_error.explanation: Isiphambano sivelana nesiNgisi, lapho ngenkathi-ke kusetshenziswa isicono sokuqeda (ngisile). NgesiNgisi, emva kwe- 'would have' kusetshenziswa past participle (lost), okungokomfanekiso ongaphambili. Khumbula ukuthi 'losed' awusekho; kufuneka uyikhumbule izicathulo ezingaphambili. Ngaphandle kwalokho, qiniseka ukuthi umsebenzi oyinguquko emva kwe- 'have' yisicathulo, hhayi isicono sokuqeda.

examples.original: If I had known, I would have come earlier.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd noʊn aɪ wʊd hæv kʌm ˈɜːrliər/
examples.note: Buka ukusetshenziswa kwe-past perfect emqondweni ('had known') kanye ne- 'would have' ekuphumeni.

examples.original: We would have won the game if the referee hadn't made that mistake.
examples.phonetic: /wiː wʊd hæv wʌn ðə ɡeɪm ɪf ðə ˌrefəˈriː ˈhædənt meɪd ðæt mɪˈsteɪk/
examples.translation: Bengizokudla umdlalo uma isihlengi asengikhombise le nkinga.
examples.note: Ekuhambiseni, kusetshenziswa 'hadn't' emqondweni kanye ne- 'wouldn't have' ekuphumeni okubi.

examples.original: I wouldn't have said that if I were you.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈwʊdənt hæv sed ðæt ɪf aɪ wɜːr juː/
examples.note: Isimo asisengokwemigaqango ngesiZulu; ngesiNgisi kusetshenziswa 'wouldn't have + past participle'.

levels.label: Should have and Could have for criticism or missed opportunities
levels.translation: Should have kanye ne-could have ukukhombisa noma izindlela ezingezikhona

examples.original: You should have told me about the meeting.
examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd hæv toʊld miː əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/
examples.note: Kusetshenziswa 'should have' ukukhombisa umsebenzi owawungenzeka noma ukuveza ukudana.

examples.original: He could have asked for help, but he didn't.
examples.phonetic: /hiː kʊd hæv æskt fɔːr hɛlp bʌt hiː ˈdɪdnt/
examples.translation: Ngekhe bekungokuba ecabanga ngesizo, kodwa akakwenzanga.
examples.note: 'Could have' kuveza indlela ebekungakhetha yona kodwa ayikhethanga.

examples.original: She shouldn't have quit her job so quickly.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈʃʊdənt hæv kwɪt hɜːr dʒɒb soʊ ˈkwɪkli/
examples.translation: Akube kwakudinga ukuba ahambe ngokushesha kwendawo yakhe yokusebenza.
examples.note: Isimo esingenasidingo 'shouldn't have' kusetshenziswa ukuveza ukuthi umsebenzi owawungenzeka bekuyinto eyibi.

levels.label: Might have and Must have for possibility and deduction
levels.translation: Might have kanye ne-must have ukubeka izindlela kanye nezingqikitho

examples.original: The keys might have fallen out of your pocket.
examples.phonetic: /ðə kiːz maɪt hæv ˈfɔːlən aʊt əv jɔːr ˈpɒkɪt/
examples.note: 'Might have' kuveza indlela ebekungakhetha yona kodwa akakhethanga.

examples.original: She must have been very tired after the trip.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː mʌst hæv bɪn ˈveri ˈtaɪərd ˈɑːftər ðə trɪp/
examples.note: 'Must have' kuveza ingqikitho eyiyona ngokwesiqotho.

examples.original: They couldn't have known about the party.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈkʊdnt hæv noʊn əˈbaʊt ðə ˈpɑːrti/
examples.note: Ukudonsa ingqikitho, kusetshenziswa 'couldn't have' ngokwesikhashana ne- 'mustn't have'.

translations.zu: Izi-Modal Ezikhulu: would have, should have, etc.

title: Participle Clauses / Amavesi e-Participle
bridge: Ngesi, siqondile ukusebenzisa izilawuli ezincane nge-'while', 'as', 'since' okanye 'after' elandelelwa yisiga eshiqiswe. KuloMzulu, ukuze kubonakele okwengeziwe okukhulunywa ngakho nokuthi kuhambisane, kusetshenzwa isilawuli se-participle (esikhathini esisa okanye esidlulile) eshinamalisa isilawuli esingcono kuso sonke. Ingalaba enkulu kuloMzulu yikuthi indaba yesilawuli esikhulu kufuneka ibe yisilawuli se-participle; uma kungakhathaliseki, kuveka umphumela othiwa 'participle odidayo' (participle odidayo) okukhuluma kakubi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, isiSpanish ivumela ngenkathi ingeri ('walking down the street, I saw...'), kodwa kuloMzulu isiga se-participle esikhathini esisa ('walking down the street, I saw...') isetshenzwe ngokwemibuzo eningi: ayikwazi ukukhuluma ngesiga esidlulile esilawulini esikhulu uma ingaphambi kwayo 'having'.
rule: Amavesi e-participle aketshwa ngesiga se-participle esikhathini esisa (-ing) okanye esiga se-participle esidlulile (-ed okanye isimo esingahambisana). Esetshenzwa ukukhuluma ngesikhathi (while, after), isizathu (because, since), umqondo (if), okanye ukubeka (although). Isilawuli se-participle siqondile ukuba sekusolo kwesilawuli okanye emva kwendaba, kendaba yesilawuli esikhulu kufuneka ibe yisilawuli se-participle. Ukusebenza ngaphambi kwesilawuli esikhulu, kusetshenzwa 'having + esiga se-participle esidlulile' (e.g., 'Having finished my homework, I went out'). Ngokukhuluma ngokwenye indlela kusetshenzwa 'being + esiga se-participle esidlulile' (e.g., 'Being late, I missed the bus'). Nalo amasetshenziswa emva kwamazwi ukushinamalisa izilawuli zokubalula (e.g., 'the man sitting there' = 'the man who is sitting there'). Awasetshenziswa nendaba eyinganingana; ngaleso sikhathi kufuneka ubeke kabusha ngokunsiza 'while', 'because', etc. nendaba eqondile.

concept_examples.text: Walking down the street, I saw an old friend.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈwɔːkɪŋ daʊn ðə striːt, aɪ sɔː ən əʊld frend/

concept_examples.text: Having finished her work, she went home.
concept_examples.translation: Emva kokugcina umsebenzi wakhe, waya ekhaya.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈhævɪŋ ˈfɪnɪʃt hɜː wɜːk, ʃiː went həʊm/

concept_examples.text: The man sitting over there is my boss.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə mæn ˈsɪtɪŋ ˈəʊvə ðeə ɪz maɪ bɒs/

concept_examples.text: Being tired, I decided to go to bed early.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈbiːɪŋ ˈtaɪəd, aɪ dɪˈsaɪdɪd tə ɡəʊ tə bed ˈɜːli/

common_error.wrong: Walking down the street, the church was seen.
common_error.correct: Walking down the street, I saw the church.
common_error.correct_alt: While I was walking down the street, I saw the church.
common_error.explanation: Impumela iyeyokuthi 'participle odidayo' (participle odidayo): isilawuli 'walking down the street' asinendaba efanayo nesilawuli esikhulu ('the church'). KuloSpanish ngenkathi kuhlekelwa okanye kusetshenzwa ngokwenye indlela, kodwa kuloMzulu akusekho. Ukuze kuqhubeke, ucinge ukuthi indaba yesilawuli esikhulu iyalenza isenzo se-participle. Uma akukho, ubeke kabusha ngokunsiza 'while', 'because', etc.

examples.original: Feeling hungry, I made a sandwich.
examples.phonetic: /ˈfiːlɪŋ ˈhʌŋɡri, aɪ meɪd ə ˈsænwɪdʒ/
examples.note: Isiga se-participle esikhathini esisa (-ing) ikhomba isizathu okanye isikhathi esifanayo. KuloSpanish kungahambisana ngerund okanye 'as' + isiga eshiqiswe.

examples.original: She left the room crying.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː left ðə ruːm ˈkraɪɪŋ/
examples.note: Uma isiga sisemva kwesiga esikhulu, ikhomba indlela okanye ukuhambisana. Qaphela: kuloMzulu awusetshenziswa 'she left crying' ngokuthi wayelela ngaphambi; kuhambisana.

examples.original: While waiting for the bus, I read a book.
examples.phonetic: /waɪl ˈweɪtɪŋ fə ðə bʌs, aɪ red ə bʊk/
examples.note: Kungasetshenziswa 'while' + isiga ukuze kukhombise ukuhambisana. Ngokungakhi 'while' njalo kuhle, kodwa 'while' kukhomba ukuhambisana kwesikhathi.

examples.original: Frightened by the noise, the cat hid under the bed.
examples.phonetic: /ˈfraɪtnd baɪ ðə nɔɪz, ðə kæt hɪd ˈʌndə ðə bed/
examples.translation: Ngokwesaba umthwalo, ikati layela phansi kwesibambo.
examples.note: Isiga se-participle esidlulile isetshenzwa ngokukhuluma ngokwenye indlela okanye isimo. Lapha 'frightened' iyisiga esikhumbuza esikhomba isimo sendaba.

examples.original: Given more time, I could finish the project.
examples.phonetic: /ˈɡɪvn mɔː taɪm, aɪ kʊd ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə ˈprɒdʒekt/
examples.translation: Uma nginike isikhathi esingakufanele, ngingahlela umsebenzi.
examples.note: Ikhomba umqondo (if + passive). KuloSpanish kusetshenzwa 'if' + subjunctive okanye 'given more time'.

examples.original: The window broken in the storm has been repaired.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɪndəʊ ˈbrəʊkən ɪn ðə stɔːm hæz biːn rɪˈpeəd/
examples.note: Njengomshintshi wamazwi, isiga se-participle esidlulile ishinamalisa isilawuli sokubalula esiphasivini.

examples.original: Having missed the train, we had to take a taxi.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhævɪŋ mɪst ðə treɪn, wiː hæd tə teɪk ə ˈtæksi/
examples.note: Usetshenzisa 'having + esiga se-participle esidlulile' ukusebenza ngaphambi kwesilawuli esikhulu. KuloSpanish kusetshenzwa 'habiendo perdido' okanye 'as we missed'.

examples.original: Not having studied enough, she failed the exam.
examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈhævɪŋ ˈstʌdɪd ɪˈnʌf, ʃiː feɪld ði ɪɡˈzæm/
examples.note: Isimo esingahambisana yenziwa ngokunsiza 'not' ngaphambi kwayo 'having'. KuloSpanish kusetshenzwa 'no habiendo' okanye 'as he did not study'.

examples.original: Having been warned about the storm, they stayed home.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhævɪŋ biːn wɔːnd əˈbaʊt ðə stɔːm, ðeɪ steɪd həʊm/
examples.note: Isimo esiphasivini esiphindwe 'having been + esiga se-participle esidlulile'. Iyofomali futhi isetshenzwa kwimibhalo okanye kwinkulumo.
